title: The muezzins will have the longest necks among the people on the Day of Judgment
hadeeth: Mu‘āwiyah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) say: "The muezzins will have the longest necks among the people on the Day of Judgment."
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) informed that the muezzins, who call to prayer, will have the longest necks on the Day of Judgment due to the honor of their work, their abundant goodness, and the greatness of their reward.
hints: The merit of the Adhān (call to prayer) and encouraging its performance.
Highlighting the honor of the muezzins and their high status on the Day of Judgment.
hadeeth_intro: Mu‘āwiyah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) say:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «الْمُؤَذِّنُونَ أَطْوَلُ النَّاسِ أَعْنَاقًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ:
explanation_ar: أخبر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن المؤذنين الذين يُنادُون بالصلاة هم أطول الناس أعناقًا يوم القيامة لشَرف عملهم، وكثرة خيرهم، وعظم أجرهم.
hints_ar: بيان شَرف المؤذنين، وعلوّ منزلتهم يوم القيامة.
